35195.title: Chamberlain-war-declaration
35195.creator: Neville Chamberlain was the original speaker.

editorial.note: Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain declaring war on Germany on September 3, 1939, at the start of World War II .

text.body: It is seventy-two years since the first inauguration of a President under our National Constitution. During that period, fifteen different and very distinguished citizens have in succession administered the executive branch of the Government. They have conducted it through many perils, and generally with great success. Yet, with all this scope for precedent, I now enter upon the same task, for the brief constitutional term of four years, under great and peculiar difficulties.
